Have you heard of MCP yet?

Model Context Protocol is an open standard that lets LLMs connect directly to external tools, databases, and APIs.

Think of it as giving your AI agent hands and feet to take real-world actions instead of just answering questions.

Who should learn it?

If you are a fresher or a backend developer looking to stand out in interviews, this is for you. Companies are moving from basic chat bots to autonomous agents, and MCP is quickly becoming the standard plumbing.

How to get started?

Start small. Do not jump into complex orchestration frameworks on day one.

Pick Python or TypeScript. Build a tiny MCP server that gives an LLM read-only access to a local SQLite database or a simple weather API.

Once you see the model fetch data on its own, study the security basics so your agent does not expose private data.
